about_the_game:
Tales of Adventure Across 10,000 Worlds!

<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-595406_c69a2a-24">
<div class="kt-block-spacer kt-block-spacer-halign-center">



The pathways to your next heroic quest are open with 
Labyrinth Adventures ! The 12 adventures found in this book, for characters of levels 1-8, are perfect for your 
Tales of the Valiant  campaign. Experience them as separate quests easily brought into your game, or string them together as an epic journey across multiple worlds in search of a shattered portal key. 

<ul> <li> Climb aboard a runaway train, hurtling between worlds, in search of its lost inventor. </li>
<li> Pull off the ultimate heist and snatch an acorn of the World Tree from a devil's hall! </li>
<li> Battle against a void cult to prevent countless worlds from utter ruin. </li>
<li> Enter the halls of a dreaming god, confront powerful void angels, and more! </li>
</ul>

<div class="wp-block-kadence-spacer aligncenter kt-block-spacer-595406_3e3665-ba">



Your path through the Labyrinth begins here. Try not to get lost. 
"
